**The largest announced budget I found is *Landfall*: approximately ₹10 crore.** Directed by Vishal Mourya and Debi Prasad Lenka, with Sabyasachi Mishra, it was reported to have finished shooting in June 2026. I couldn’t verify a theatrical release, so this is an **announced production-budget record**, not a confirmed record among released films. [Production report](https://odiacelebrity.com/landfall-wraps-shooting-sets-stage-for-a-landmark-chapter-in-odia-cinema/).

For commercial performance, here is a **provisional top five by reported box-office collections, checked on 25 October 2026**:

| Rank | Film | Year | Reported collections |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | **Bou Buttu Bhuta** | 2025 | Approximately **₹21 crore** |
| 2 | **Jadi: The Untold Side of If** | 2026 | **Over ₹8 crore**, with its run continuing |
| 3 | **Daman** | 2022 | Approximately **₹7.5 crore** |
| 4 | **Karma** | 2024 | Approximately **₹6.5 crore** |
| 5 | **Mantra Muugdha** | 2026 | Approximately **₹4.27 crore**, tracker estimate |

Sources: [Bou Buttu Bhuta’s reported total](https://odishabytes.com/historic-highs-for-odisha-national-ott-awards-glory/amp/), [Jadi’s October report](https://cinejosh.com/news/1/130774/odia-blockbuster-film-jadi-releasing-in-telugu.html), [Daman and Karma figures](https://www.pinkvilla.com/entertainment/box-office/box-office-bau-buttu-bhuta-emerges-1-odia-film-of-all-time-to-take-on-jawan-kgf-and-bahubali-2-in-odisha-1392081), [Mantra Muugdha tracker](https://www.ollypedia.in/box-office/mantra-muugdha-2026).

**These are reported earnings, not audited profits.** Sources disagree on totals and geographical coverage; the fifth position is particularly tentative. *Bou Buttu Bhuta* is the clearest commercial landmark, while a definitive ranking needs consistent worldwide-gross figures for every film.
